377: /**
378:  * M7：把事件回放项映射成 SSE 事件名。
379:  *
380:  * 后端对无法识别的事件返回空串；前端只接受白名单内的事件，空串/未知事件
381:  * 返回 null 由调用方跳过并记录，绝不根据 `type` 猜测事件名。
382:  */
383: export function eventNameOfRunEvent(event: Pick<RunEvent, 'event'>): ChatEventName | null {
384:   return event.event && isChatEvent(event.event) ? event.event : null
385: }
386: 
387: export function reduceChat(state: ChatState, event: ChatEventName, raw: unknown): ChatState {
388:   const data = asRecord(raw)
389:   const seq = typeof data.seq === 'number' ? data.seq : null
390:   if (seq !== null && seq <= state.lastSeq) return state
391: 
392:   const next: ChatState = {
393:     ...state,
394:     lastSeq: seq ?? state.lastSeq,
395:     process: [...state.process],
396:     messages: [...state.messages],
397:   }
398: 
399:   switch (event) {
400:     case 'ping':
401:       return state
402: 
403:     case 'conversation.created': {
404:       next.conversationId = str(data.conversation_id) || state.conversationId
405:       next.conversationTitle = str(data.title) || state.conversationTitle
406:       return next
407:     }
408: 
409:     case 'run.started': {
410:       next.conversationId = str(data.conversation_id) || state.conversationId
411:       next.runId = str(data.run_id) || state.runId
412:       next.runStatus = 'running'
413:       next.streaming = true
414:       next.finishReason = null
415:       next.error = null
416:       next.recovery = null
417:       next.usage = null
418:       next.pendingApprovalId = null
419:       next.pendingApprovalIds = []
420:       next.currentAssistantId = null
421:       next.process = []
422:       return next
423:     }
424: 
425:     case 'message.created': {
426:       const messageId = str(data.message_id)
427:       if (!messageId) return next
428:       const clientId = str(data.client_message_id)
429:       const index = clientId
430:         ? next.messages.findIndex((message) => message.client_message_id === clientId)
431:         : -1
432:       if (index >= 0) {
433:         const existing = next.messages[index]
434:         if (existing) {
435:           next.messages[index] = { ...existing, id: messageId, status: 'completed' }
436:         }
437:       } else {
438:         next.messages = [
439:           ...next.messages,
440:           {
441:             ...assistantMessage(messageId, next.runId, str(data.created_at) || undefined),
442:             role: 'user',
443:             streaming: false,
444:           },
445:         ]
446:       }
447:       return next
448:     }
449: 
450:     case 'message.started': {
451:       const messageId = str(data.message_id)
452:       if (!messageId) return next
453:       if (!next.messages.some((message) => message.id === messageId)) {
454:         next.messages = [
455:           ...next.messages,
456:           assistantMessage(messageId, next.runId, str(data.started_at) || undefined),
457:         ]
458:       }
459:       next.currentAssistantId = messageId
460:       return next
461:     }
462: 
463:     case 'message.delta': {
464:       const messageId = str(data.message_id)
465:       const delta = str(data.delta)
466:       if (!messageId || !delta) return next
467:       if (!next.messages.some((message) => message.id === messageId)) {
468:         next.messages = [...next.messages, assistantMessage(messageId, next.runId)]
469:       }
470:       next.messages = updateMessage(next.messages, messageId, (message) => ({
471:         ...message,
472:         content: message.content + delta,
473:         streaming: true,
474:       }))
475:       next.currentAssistantId = messageId
476:       next.streaming = true
477:       return next
478:     }
479: 
480:     case 'reasoning.delta': {
481:       const messageId = str(data.message_id)
482:       const delta = str(data.delta)
483:       if (!messageId || !delta) return next
484:       if (!next.messages.some((message) => message.id === messageId)) {
485:         next.messages = [...next.messages, assistantMessage(messageId, next.runId)]
486:       }
487:       next.messages = updateMessage(next.messages, messageId, (message) => ({
488:         ...message,
489:         reasoning: {
490:           content: (message.reasoning?.content ?? '') + delta,
491:           durationMs: message.reasoning?.durationMs ?? null,
492:           tokens: message.reasoning?.tokens ?? null,
493:           done: false,
494:         },
495:       }))
496:       return next
497:     }
498: 
499:     case 'reasoning.done': {
500:       const messageId = str(data.message_id)
501:       if (!messageId) return next
502:       next.messages = updateMessage(next.messages, messageId, (message) => ({
503:         ...message,
504:         reasoning: {
505:           content: message.reasoning?.content ?? str(data.summary),
506:           durationMs: numOrNull(data.duration_ms),
507:           tokens: numOrNull(data.tokens),
508:           done: true,
509:         },
510:       }))
511:       return next
512:     }
513: 
514:     case 'skill.activated': {
515:       const skillId = str(data.skill_id) || `skill-${next.lastSeq}`
516:       const item: SkillProcess = {
517:         kind: 'skill',
518:         id: `skill:${skillId}`,
519:         status: 'ok',
520:         startedAt: str(data.ts),
521:         durationMs: numOrNull(data.duration_ms),
522:         skillId,
523:         slug: str(data.slug),
524:         name: str(data.name) || str(data.slug),
525:         scope: str(data.scope),
526:         description: str(data.description),
527:         estimatedTokens: numOrNull(data.estimated_tokens),
528:       }
529:       next.process = upsertProcess(next.process, item)
530:       return next
531:     }
532: 
533:     case 'tool.start':
534:       return addToolStart(next, data)
535: 
536:     case 'tool.result':
537:       return addToolResult(next, data)
538: 
539:     case 'a2a.task':
540:       return addA2aTask(next, data)
541: 
542:     case 'a2a.artifact': {
543:       const taskId = str(data.task_id)
544:       if (!taskId) return next
545:       const artifact = asRecord(data.artifact)
546:       const existing = next.process.find(
547:         (item): item is A2aProcess => item.kind === 'a2a' && item.taskId === taskId,
548:       )
549:       if (!existing) return next
550:       next.process = upsertProcess(next.process, {
551:         ...existing,
552:         artifactSummary: str(artifact.summary),
553:       })
554:       return next
555:     }
556: 
557:     case 'a2a.input_required':
558:     case 'a2a.auth_required': {
559:       const taskId = str(data.task_id)
560:       if (!taskId) return next
561:       const existing = next.process.find(
562:         (item): item is A2aProcess => item.kind === 'a2a' && item.taskId === taskId,
563:       )
564:       const agentDetail = asRecord(data.agent_detail)
565:       const item: A2aProcess = existing
566:         ? {
567:             ...existing,
568:             status: 'waiting',
569:             state: event === 'a2a.input_required' ? 'input_required' : 'auth_required',
570:           }
571:         : {
572:             kind: 'a2a',
573:             id: `a2a:${taskId}`,
574:             status: 'waiting',
575:             startedAt: str(data.ts),
576:             durationMs: null,
577:             taskId,
578:             a2aTaskId: str(data.a2a_task_id),
579:             agent: str(data.agent),
580:             agentName: str(agentDetail.name) || str(data.agent),
581:             state: event === 'a2a.input_required' ? 'input_required' : 'auth_required',
582:             progress: null,
583:             requestSummary: '',
584:             resultSummary: '',
585:             artifactSummary: '',
586:             error: null,
587:           }
588:       next.process = upsertProcess(next.process, item)
589:       return next
590:     }
591: 
592:     case 'approval.required': {
593:       const approvalId = str(data.approval_id)
594:       if (!approvalId) return next
595:       const item: ApprovalProcess = {
596:         kind: 'approval',
597:         id: `approval:${approvalId}`,
598:         status: 'waiting',
599:         startedAt: str(data.ts),
600:         approvalId,
601:         toolCallId: str(data.tool_call_id) || undefined,
602:         tool: str(data.tool),
603:         toolDisplayName: str(data.tool_display_name) || str(data.tool),
604:         source: str(data.source),
605:         executor: str(data.executor),
606:         target: str(data.target),
607:         sideEffect: str(data.side_effect),
608:         risk: str(data.risk),
609:         reason: str(data.reason),
610:         payload: data.payload && typeof data.payload === 'object' ? asRecord(data.payload) : undefined,
611:         payloadPreview: str(data.payload_preview) || undefined,
612:         expiresAt: str(data.expires_at) || null,
613:         decision: null,
614:       }
615:       next.process = upsertProcess(next.process, item)
616:       // 一轮可能有多个审批；run 状态等后端 `run.interrupted` 再收敛。
617:       next.pendingApprovalIds = next.pendingApprovalIds.includes(approvalId)
618:         ? next.pendingApprovalIds
619:         : [...next.pendingApprovalIds, approvalId]
620:       next.pendingApprovalId = next.pendingApprovalIds[0] ?? null
621:       return next
622:     }
623: 
624:     case 'run.interrupted': {
625:       next.runId = str(data.run_id) || next.runId
626:       next.runStatus = 'interrupted'
627:       // SSE 保持连接（等待审批）；输入栏仍按执行中处理。
628:       next.streaming = true
629:       next.recovery = null
630:       const approvals = Array.isArray(data.approvals)
631:         ? data.approvals.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
632:         : []
633:       next.pendingApprovalIds = approvals
634:       next.pendingApprovalId = approvals[0] ?? null
635:       const usage = asUsage(data.usage)
636:       if (usage) next.usage = usage
637:       if (Array.isArray(data.citations) && next.currentAssistantId) {
638:         const citations = data.citations as Citation[]
639:         next.messages = updateMessage(next.messages, next.currentAssistantId, (message) => ({
640:           ...message,
641:           citations,
642:         }))
643:       }
644:       return next
645:     }
646: 
647:     case 'run.resumed': {
648:       next.runId = str(data.run_id) || next.runId
649:       next.runStatus = 'running'
650:       next.streaming = true
651:       next.finishReason = null
652:       next.error = null
653:       next.recovery = null
654:       next.process = next.process.map((item) =>
655:         item.kind === 'approval' && item.status === 'waiting'
656:           ? ({ ...item, status: 'ok' } satisfies ApprovalProcess)
657:           : item,
658:       )
659:       next.pendingApprovalIds = []
660:       next.pendingApprovalId = null
661:       return next
662:     }
663: 
664:     case 'workflow.step': {
665:       const workflowId = str(data.workflow_id)
666:       const stepIndex = typeof data.step_index === 'number' ? data.step_index : null
667:       if (!workflowId || stepIndex === null) return next
668:       const item: WorkflowStepProcess = {
669:         kind: 'workflow',
670:         id: `workflow:${workflowId}:${stepIndex}`,
671:         status: mapWorkflowStatus(str(data.status)),
672:         startedAt: str(data.ts),
673:         durationMs: numOrNull(data.duration_ms),
674:         workflowId,
675:         stepIndex,
676:         stepType: str(data.step_type),
677:         name: str(data.name),
678:       }
679:       next.process = upsertProcess(next.process, item)
680:       return next
681:     }
682: 
683:     case 'memory.saved': {
684:       const item: NoticeProcess = {
685:         kind: 'notice',
686:         id: `memory:${str(data.memory_id) || next.lastSeq}`,
687:         status: 'ok',
688:         startedAt: str(data.ts),
689:         level: 'info',
690:         code: 'memory_saved',
691:         message: str(data.preview),
692:         retryable: false,
693:       }
694:       next.process = upsertProcess(next.process, item)
695:       return next
696:     }
697: 
698:     case 'notice': {
699:       const item: NoticeProcess = {
700:         kind: 'notice',
701:         id: `notice:${next.lastSeq}`,
702:         status: str(data.level) === 'error' ? 'error' : 'ok',
703:         startedAt: str(data.ts),
704:         level:
705:           data.level === 'error' || data.level === 'warn' || data.level === 'info'
706:             ? data.level
707:             : 'info',
708:         code: str(data.code),
709:         message: str(data.message),
710:         retryable: data.retryable === true,
711:       }
712:       next.process = upsertProcess(next.process, item)
713:       return next
714:     }
715: 
716:     case 'error': {
717:       const error: MessageError = {
718:         code: str(data.code) || 'stream_error',
719:         message: str(data.message) || '生成失败',
720:         retryable: data.retryable === true,
721:         requestId: str(data.request_id) || undefined,
722:       }
723:       next.error = error
724:       next.streaming = false
725:       next.runStatus = 'failed'
726:       next.pendingApprovalIds = []
727:       next.pendingApprovalId = null
728:       const item: ErrorProcess = {
729:         kind: 'error',
730:         id: `error:${next.lastSeq}`,
731:         status: 'error',
732:         startedAt: str(data.ts),
733:         code: error.code,
734:         message: error.message,
735:       }
736:       next.process = upsertProcess(next.process, item)
737:       if (next.currentAssistantId) {
738:         next.messages = updateMessage(next.messages, next.currentAssistantId, (message) => ({
739:           ...message,
740:           streaming: false,
741:           status: 'failed',
742:           error,
743:         }))
744:       }
745:       return next
746:     }
747: 
748:     case 'message.done': {
749:       const messageId = str(data.message_id)
750:       const finishReason = str(data.finish_reason) || 'stop'
751:       const reason = str(data.reason)
752:       const usage = asUsage(data.usage)
753:       const citations = Array.isArray(data.citations) ? (data.citations as Citation[]) : []
754:       const artifacts = Array.isArray(data.artifacts) ? (data.artifacts as MessageArtifact[]) : []
755:       const reasoning = asReasons(data.reasoning)
756:       const status =
757:         finishReason === 'stop' ? 'completed' : finishReason === 'error' ? 'failed' : 'canceled'
758: 
759:       if (messageId && !next.messages.some((message) => message.id === messageId)) {
760:         next.messages = [...next.messages, assistantMessage(messageId, next.runId)]
761:       }
762:       if (messageId) {
763:         next.messages = updateMessage(next.messages, messageId, (message) => ({
764:           ...message,
765:           streaming: false,
766:           status,
767:           usage: usage ?? message.usage,
768:           citations: citations.length > 0 ? citations : message.citations,
769:           artifacts: artifacts.length > 0 ? artifacts : message.artifacts,
770:           reasoning: reasoning
771:             ? {
772:                 content: message.reasoning?.content || reasoning.summary,
773:                 durationMs: reasoning.duration_ms,
774:                 tokens: reasoning.tokens,
775:                 done: true,
776:               }
777:             : message.reasoning,
778:         }))
779:       }
780: 
781:       next.streaming = false
782:       next.finishReason = finishReason
783:       next.runStatus = runStatusFromFinishReason(finishReason)
784:       next.usage = usage
785:       next.currentAssistantId = null
786: 
787:       const timedOut = finishReason === 'canceled' && reason === 'approval_timeout'
788:       const legacyInterrupted = finishReason === 'interrupted'
789:       if (timedOut) {
790:         // M5：审批超时后 run 终态 canceled；过期审批不可再操作。
791:         next.process = next.process.map((item) =>
792:           item.kind === 'approval' && item.status === 'waiting'
793:             ? ({ ...item, status: 'canceled' } satisfies ApprovalProcess)
794:             : item,
795:         )
796:         next.pendingApprovalIds = []
797:         next.pendingApprovalId = null
798:         next.recovery = {
799:           kind: 'approval_timeout',
800:           code: 'approval_timeout',
801:           message: '审批超时，本轮运行已取消；该操作没有执行。如仍需要，请重新发送。',
802:           runId: next.runId,
803:           runStatus: 'canceled',
804:           retryable: false,
805:         }
806:       } else if (legacyInterrupted) {
807:         // 兼容 M4 契约（M5 已改为 run.interrupted + 后续 run.resumed）。
808:         next.recovery = {
809:           kind: 'run_interrupted',
810:           code: 'run_interrupted',
811:           message: '本轮运行正在等待审批；处理后才会继续。',
812:           runId: next.runId,
813:           runStatus: 'interrupted',
814:           retryable: false,
815:         }
816:       } else {
817:         next.process = next.process.map((item) =>
818:           item.kind === 'approval' && item.status === 'waiting'
819:             ? ({ ...item, status: 'canceled' } satisfies ApprovalProcess)
820:             : item,
821:         )
822:         next.pendingApprovalIds = []
823:         next.pendingApprovalId = null
824:         next.recovery = null
825:       }
826:       return next
827:     }
828: 
829:     default:
830:       return state
831:   }
832: }

834: /** 审批决定后同步过程卡片，避免等待下一次事件。 */
835: export function markApprovalResolved(
836:   state: ChatState,
837:   approvalId: string,
838:   decision: 'approve' | 'reject',
839: ): ChatState {
840:   const items = state.process.map((item) => {
841:     if (item.kind !== 'approval' || item.approvalId !== approvalId) return item
842:     return {
843:       ...item,
844:       decision,
845:       status: decision === 'approve' ? 'ok' : 'canceled',
846:     } satisfies ApprovalProcess
847:   })
848:   const pending = (state.pendingApprovalIds ?? []).filter((id) => id !== approvalId)
849:   return {
850:     ...state,
851:     process: items,
852:     pendingApprovalIds: pending,
853:     pendingApprovalId: pending[0] ?? null,

But runsApi.stream already does refresh and retry once; second 401 triggers notifyUnauthorized then throws retryError. Then performReconnect catch 401 4xx -> handleApiFailure -> notifyUnauthorized again maybe double. Minor.

Actually connectRunStream calls `handlers.onOpen?.(response.headers.get('X-Run-ID'))`. performReconnect passes `() => onOpen(runId, false)` discarding the header. But runsApi.stream already does refresh and retry once; second 401 triggers notifyUnauthorized then throws retryError. Then performReconnect catch 401 4xx -> handleApiFailure -> notifyUnauthorized again maybe double. Minor.

b) `onOpen` callback in performReconnect: `onOpen(runId, false)` — ignores X-Run-ID header; if server returns a different run ID in header, onOpen's runChanged logic doesn't fire since passed current runId. Actually connectRunStream calls `handlers.onOpen?.(response.headers.get('X-Run-ID'))`. performReconnect passes `() => onOpen(runId, false)` discarding the header. The comment in onOpen says "重连若拿到不同的 run（后端违背幂等契约）保留旧 lastSeq 会丢弃新 run seq" — but in performReconnect the header value is discarded, so runChanged can't be detected. But note: enterDegraded called from catch; `finally` runs after: `settled` true so no extra refresh. Good.

d) 404: refreshHistory. But it sets `state.value = { streaming:false, recovery:null }` and `connection idle`; but does it clear polling? performReconnect didn't start polling. Could scheduling polling happen while a reconnect is pending? `refresh()` calls adoptRun if streaming or interrupted. adoptRun clears polling at start, and it may call schedulePolling. But if scheduleReconnect timer pending? `refresh()` called by UI while reconnecting? adoptRun doesn't reset reconnect budget/timer, so it could leave a reconnect timer and start polling simultaneously. But this is pre-existing (refresh path in M6? performReconnect change only). Hmm, the M7 change removed re-POST and uses GET stream. The question says focus on reconnect/polling coexistence. Let me look for actual new bugs introduced by M7.

e) The important one: after `runsApi.stream` resolves normally (server closed stream at terminal). In connectRunStream, `onclose` invokes handlers.onClose -> onStreamClose. Then performReconnect after await: checks finishReason !== null so doesn't schedule. finally: settled false, controller not aborted, !isReconnecting() (connection likely 'open' from onOpen) -> sets connection idle, streaming false, refreshHistory. On reconnect, onOpen resets? onOpen(runId,false) sets lastSeq = resetSeq||runChanged ? 0 : state.value.lastSeq — retains. Then server replays events after lastSeq. reduceChat drops seq <= lastSeq. g) A key issue: `runsApi.stream` retry-on-401. It calls `refreshSession()` which likely refreshes tokens; retries streamOnce with same handlers. But handlers' signal may be aborted? Not issue. However `onerror` in connectRunStream throws ApiRequestError, fetchEventSource's behavior: onerror throwing causes fetchEventSource to reject; does it also call onclose? Probably not. Fine.

h) `runsApi.stream` 401 retry calls `streamOnce`; but if the retry fails with 401, notifyUnauthorized; then throws retryError. In performReconnect, handleApiFailure -> 401 -> notifyUnauthorized again (duplicate) — client notifyUnauthorized likely idempotent. Minor.

- 前端动作筛选内置后端 38 个实际动作（`AUDIT_ACTIONS`），允许自由输入；`detail` 用 `RedactedJson` 默认遮罩敏感键。

### 12.3 平台密钥（仅管理员）

- `GET /admin/secrets?enabled=` → `{items:[{name,description,enabled,created_at,updated_at}]}`；
- `POST /admin/secrets` 201，`PATCH /admin/secrets/{name}` 200，`DELETE` 204；
- 永不回显明文/密文；无 `CAPABILITY_SECRET_KEY` 时写入 **503 `secret_store_unavailable`**；非管理员 **403**；删除不检查引用；
- 名称规则 `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$`；前端新建/轮换后提示「明文不会再次显示」。

### 12.4 限流与安全 UX

- 聊天 429 `rate_limited`：`error.details.retry_after_seconds` 驱动输入栏倒计时并禁用发送；
- 登录/注册 429：同一字段驱动提交按钮倒计时；
- 409/401/403 均按业务语义提示；401 由全局单飞刷新失败后跳登录并提示「登录已过期」；
- Markdown 外链：同源/锚点/`mailto:`/`tel:` 直接放行，其他域名二次确认后 `noopener,noreferrer` 新标签打开；
- 输出打码与注入检测由后端完成，前端不新增假 UI；审计页可检索 `security.injection_suspected` / `security.output_redacted`。

### 12.5 断线续流现状（M7 已接入，2026-11-11）

后端 M7 已交付：`RunEventOut` 新增 `event` 字段，并新增 `GET /runs/{id}/stream?after_seq=` SSE 续流端点。前端已按下一节接入：

- 断线重连改为**续流优先**：`GET /runs/{id}` 校验 → `runsApi.stream(runId, lastSeq)` → 回放已落库事件 + 跟随实时；
- `lastSeq` 单调去重，回放与实时事件走同一个 `reduceChat`；
- 400 `replay_too_large` / 404 / 连接失败回退「轮询 + 待审批补卡 + 终态 `refreshHistory()`」；
- `message.delta` 不落库，断线窗口内的逐字文本仍由终态 `refreshHistory()` 补齐，不承诺逐字续传；
- 进入会话/恢复运行时会用 `GET /runs/{id}/events` 的 `event` 回放补卡（工具/审批/通知等）。

真实证据：`scripts/smoke-m7-backend.mjs` 48 项（2026-11-11 实测）、`scripts/real-m7.spec.ts`、`pnpm test` 中的续流/回放单测。

## 13. M7–M9 契约增量（2026-11-11）

> 状态：**M7 后端已落地（2026-11-11），前端已接入并完成真实联调**；M8/M9 仍为已立项、未开始的草案，落地以后端 handoff 与 OpenAPI 为准。对照设计见 [`superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-m7-m9-frontend-alignment-design.md`](superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-m7-m9-frontend-alignment-design.md)。

### 13.1 事件回放补 `event`

```http
GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/events?after_seq=0&limit=100
```

响应元素（`RunEventOut`）新增：

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `event` | string | 原始 SSE 事件名，如 `message.delta`、`approval.required`、`message.done`；未知时 `""` |

- `type` 仍保留分类；`payload` 仍剔除 `_event`；
- 前端读取 `event` 驱动 reducer；`event` 为空/缺失时按未知事件忽略并记录 `type`/`seq`，不猜测事件名。

### 13.2 SSE 续流端点

```http
GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/stream?after_seq=0
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Accept: text/event-stream
```

- 帧格式与 `POST /chat/stream` 一致：`id: <seq>`、`event: <名称>`、`data: <JSON>`，每 15s `: ping`；
- 先回放 `seq > after_seq` 的已落库事件，再订阅实时事件；终态事件后关闭；
- run 已终态：回放完立即关闭；`interrupted`：保持连接等审批恢复；
- 错误：401 未登录；404 非本人/不存在；400 `replay_too_large`（回放 >1000 条，回退分页或更近的 `after_seq`）；
- 单实例；不支持 `Last-Event-ID`；
- 前端用 `@microsoft/fetch-event-source`（GET + Bearer）。

```ts
import { fetchEventSource } from '@microsoft/fetch-event-source'

const controller = new AbortController()
let lastSeq = 0

await fetchEventSource(`/api/v1/runs/${runId}/stream?after_seq=${lastSeq}`, {
  method: 'GET',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, Accept: 'text/event-stream' },
  signal: controller.signal,
  openWhenHidden: true,
  onmessage(ev) {
    if (!ev.event || ev.event === 'ping') return
    const seq = Number(ev.id)
    if (seq <= lastSeq) return // 去重，只前进
    lastSeq = seq
    handleEvent(ev.event, JSON.parse(ev.data))
    if (isTerminal(ev.event)) controller.abort() // message.done 等终态：停止，不再重连
  },
  onclose() {
    // 服务端终态关闭：不重试；需要时由调用方触发 refreshHistory()
    controller.abort()
  },
  onerror(err) {
    // 400 replay_too_large / 401 / 404：不重试，转轮询或刷新
    // 网络错误：交给调用方有限重试
    throw err
  },
})
```

续流失败或 400 时回退现有轮询；收到终态事件后停止续流并 `refreshHistory()`。

### 13.3 agents/tasks 写操作 403

- agents 写接口：`POST /agents`、`PATCH/DELETE /agents/{id}`、`POST /agents/{id}/refresh`、`POST /agents/{id}/health`；
- tasks 动作接口：`POST /tasks/{id}/cancel|resume|authorize|reject`；
- 普通用户返回 **403 `forbidden`**，`details.required_role="admin"`；被拒绝的写操作后端记 `security.rbac_denied`；
- 读接口 `GET /agents*`、`GET /tasks*` 与 `POST /agents/preview` 保持登录用户可用；
- 前端按 `user.role === 'admin'` 显示写入口；403 文案「当前账号无管理员权限」，不当作登录失效。

### 13.4 `approval.required` 补 5 字段

`approval.required.data` 新增 `tool_display_name`、`executor`、`target`、`side_effect`、`payload_preview`（`payload_preview` ≤500 字符、`target` ≤2000 字符）。前端可直接渲染审批卡，`GET /approvals?run_id=` 保留为字段缺失时的兜底。

### 13.5 A2A 授权 URL 白名单

- 后端只允许 `https`，dev/test 额外允许 `http://localhost`、`http://127.0.0.1`；非法协议、内网/回环（prod）、超长（>2000）置 `authorization_url=null`；
- 前端已有「仅 https/本地 http」判断；无链接时显示「授权链接不可用，请联系管理员」。

### 13.6 M8 管理台端点（草案）

| 能力 | 端点 |
|---|---|
| 概览 | `GET /admin/overview` |
| 用户 | `GET /admin/users`、`GET /admin/users/{id}`、`PATCH /admin/users/{id}`（不能修改自己的 role、不能禁用/降级最后一个 admin（自己能否改 status 以 M8 handoff 为准）） |
| 平台指令 | `GET/PUT /admin/settings/instruction` |

## 1. 一句话结论

前端已消费后端 M7 全部能力：断线从 `lastSeq` **续流优先**（回放已落库事件 + 实时增量，400/404/失败回退轮询）、事件回放 `event` 驱动 reducer 补卡、agents/tasks 写入口按管理员显隐、审批 5 字段与脱敏预览、A2A 授权链接白名单容错、登录 401 与 403/503 文案收口、Nginx 续流 location。`smoke:m7` 48 项与 `test:real` M7 5 例在真实后端通过；全量 `pnpm test` 317 例、`pnpm e2e` 28 例全绿。

## 2. 后端 M7 实际契约（已核实）

| 契约 | 实际行为 |
|---|---|

## 5. 行为变更（需要知晓）

1. **重连语义变化**：M6 断线重连会重发 `POST /chat/stream`（同一 `client_message_id` 幂等）；M7 起改为 `GET /runs/{id}/stream?after_seq=lastSeq`，不再重发消息、不再新建 run。
2. **普通用户写入口消失**：M7 前普通用户可调用 agents/tasks 写接口（前端只是隐藏入口），后端 M7 后统一 403；前端改为不渲染入口（含两个详情抽屉），并补了「入口不可见 + 直接调用 403」两层回归。
3. **登录 401 文案**：不再进入 refresh 流程，密码错误直接显示后端「邮箱或密码错误」。
4. **403/503 文案集中收敛**：`apiErrorFromResponse` 统一覆写，页面无需各自判断。
5. **审批卡**：有事件字段时不再依赖详情请求；`payload_preview` 是脱敏预览，完整 payload 仍可展开。

## 6. 未做项与限制

- **逐字续传不承诺**：`message.delta` 不落库，断线窗口内文本由终态 `refreshHistory()` 补齐；这是后端 M7 非目标。
- **真实长流证据受限**：本机 `LLM_API_KEY` 为占位，聊天 run 以 `llm_error` 结束；续流证据覆盖「回放 + 终态关闭 + after_seq 去重」，未覆盖「真实增量 delta 续流」。
- **Nginx 未在生产端口端到端验证**：`deploy/nginx.conf` 做了容器内 `nginx -t` 与静态断言；`verify:nginx` 完整对照实测验证的是「逐帧 vs 缓冲」语义，不覆盖真实续流 + Bearer。
- **多实例**：续流依赖后端进程内事件总线，前端不做跨实例假设。
- **E2E 仍只跑 mock 构建**：续流状态机证据在 store 单测与 `test:real`，Playwright 未新增断线续流用例。
- **本次未推送远端、未删除分支**（按用户偏好留给用户）。

    runId: string,

  ): PageResult<RunEvent> | null {
    const events = this.runEvents[runId]
    if (!events) return null
    const groups: Record<string, string[]> = {
      message: ['request', 'message'],
      tool: ['skill', 'tool'],
      a2a: ['a2a'],
      mcp: ['mcp'],
      approval: ['approval'],
      workflow: ['workflow'],

      .split(',')
      .map((item) => item.trim())
      .filter(Boolean)
    const allowed = requested.flatMap((type) => groups[type] ?? [type])
    const keyword = query.q?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? ''
    const filtered = events
      .filter((event) => (query.after_seq ? event.seq > query.after_seq : true))
      .filter((event) => (allowed.length ? allowed.includes(event.type) : true))
      .filter((event) =>
        keyword ? `${event.title} ${event.subtitle}`.toLowerCase().includes(keyword) : true,
      )
    return paginate(filtered, query)
  }

But important: mock fixture `approval.required` payload lacks many fields; the replay in adoptRun would add approval card; then syncPendingApprovals fallback. Fine.

Now, a real issue: **`mockDb.listRunEvents` uses `query.after_seq ? event.seq > query.after_seq : true`** — if after_seq=0, falsy → returns all. That's correct semantics. Fine.

**Mock appendRunEvent seq collision**: `seq` per chat stream increments from 1. Any event whose frame.data contains `seq`? `emit` builds `{...data, run_id, ts, seq}` overriding. So seq increments. Since a new run has its own runEvents array empty; fine. But when `mockDb.upsertRun` is called and `runEvents[runId]` exists (e.g., fixture? no new UUID), fine.

**Bug in mockRunStream replay then live**: It replays `listRunEvents` snapshot, then if not terminal subscribes. Between the replay query and subscription, events could be emitted and missed (race). In JS single-threaded, no await between listRunEvents and subscribe except the `await sleep(frameDelay)` in loop — during replay frames, live events can be emitted by mockChatStream between sleeps. They would be missed because subscription happens only after replay. In the real backend, the server handles replay+live subscription atomically-ish (or event bus). This is a mock fidelity issue: e.g., after a disconnect during an active mock chat, reconnect replays stored events with 30ms delays, and new live events emitted during that replay window are appended to runEvents but not replayed again (query snapshot taken before), not delivered live until subscription—**lost events**. Could this cause a test flake? Maybe not tested. But is it a real mock flow issue? Potentially. Though in mock chat, when the stream drops, the mock chat stream continues (it's in-process and not actually dropped unless aborted). How would reconnect happen in mock? The mock chat stream only ends by abort; when stop() aborts, run canceled. If network drop simulated? The question asks mock 与真实契约一致性 and replay/live semantics. This is a plausible Important (mock does not guarantee replay→live handoff). But is it "有证据"? Code lines 770-790. Yes.

More important mock issue: **mock run.started / message.created / message.started are persisted and replayed**. `message.created` replay creates a user message if not found by client_message_id; in replay, the user message was already saved to mockDb after prefix play. adoptRun first fetches messages? For initial load, loadConversation messages include user message; replay message.created finds it by client_message_id (payload has it) and sets id. Fine.

But **replaying `message.started` / `message.delta`**: deltas not stored. `message.started` persisted; replay creates assistant message with empty content if not present. Then `message.done` replay updates it with status etc but content empty. But refreshHistory at terminal fixes. For interrupted, assistant message not yet saved? In mock approval flow, saveAssistantMessage only at end. Replay of message.started creates an empty assistant message; then in the chat UI it shows empty streaming? state.streaming set true by message.started? reducer message.started doesn't set streaming true (only currentAssistantId). assistantMessage has streaming true. After adoptRun, state.streaming false (interrupted) but the message might show streaming spinner forever? <script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, nextTick, onMounted, onUnmounted, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import { useRoute, useRouter } from 'vue-router'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'

import ChatComposer from '@/components/chat/ChatComposer.vue'
import AgentOutputDrawer from '@/components/chat/AgentOutputDrawer.vue'
import ConnectionBanner from '@/components/chat/ConnectionBanner.vue'
import MessageList from '@/components/chat/MessageList.vue'
import RunRecoveryBanner from '@/components/chat/RunRecoveryBanner.vue'
import RunTraceDrawer from '@/components/chat/RunTraceDrawer.vue'
import RunTracePanel from '@/components/chat/RunTracePanel.vue'
import ErrorState from '@/components/common/ErrorState.vue'
import { useMediaQuery } from '@/composables/useMediaQuery'
import { useCapabilitiesStore } from '@/stores/capabilities'
import { useChatStore } from '@/stores/chat'
import { useConversationsStore } from '@/stores/conversations'
import { useSystemStore } from '@/stores/system'
import type { A2aProcess, ApprovalProcess, ChatContextSelection, ReasoningEffortId } from '@/types'
import { withModelSelection } from '@/utils/chatSelection'

const route = useRoute()
const router = useRouter()
const chat = useChatStore()
const conversations = useConversationsStore()
const system = useSystemStore()
const capabilityCatalog = useCapabilitiesStore()

const traceOpen = ref(false)
const agentOutputOpen = ref(false)
const agentOutputId = ref<string | null>(null)
/** 原型：>1180px 运行轨迹常驻右栏，窄屏回退为抽屉。 */
const narrowTrace = useMediaQuery('(max-width: 1180px)')
const model = ref('')
const reasoningEffort = ref<ReasoningEffortId>('low')
const messageListRef = ref<InstanceType<typeof MessageList> | null>(null)

onUnmounted(() => {
  // 离开对话页只停前端重连，不取消后端 run（约定断线不取消）。
  if (chat.connection === 'reconnecting') chat.stopReconnect()
})

const suggestions = [
  '整理本周客服工单，生成一份团队周报',
  '查一下退款政策变更会影响哪些话术',
  '把这段 release notes 翻成英文',
]

const BLOCKED_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  workflows: '工作流',
  agents: '智能体',
  tasks: '任务',
  knowledge: '知识库',
}

const activeId = computed(() => (typeof route.query.c === 'string' ? route.query.c : undefined))
const activeConversation = computed(
  () => conversations.items.find((item) => item.id === activeId.value) ?? null,
)
const title = computed(
  () => chat.state.conversationTitle || activeConversation.value?.title || '新对话',
)
const isEmpty = computed(() => !activeId.value && chat.state.messages.length === 0)

const status = computed(() => {
  if (chat.pendingApprovals.length > 0) return { label: '待审批', tone: 'warn' }
  if (chat.state.recovery?.kind === 'run_interrupted') return { label: '待处理', tone: 'warn' }
  if (chat.state.recovery?.kind === 'approval_timeout') return { label: '已超时', tone: 'error' }
  if (chat.state.streaming) return { label: '生成中', tone: 'live' }
  if (chat.state.recovery?.kind === 'run_in_progress') return { label: '运行中', tone: 'live' }
  if (chat.state.error) return { label: '出错', tone: 'error' }
  return { label: '就绪', tone: 'ok' }
})

const subtitle = computed(() => {
  const parts: string[] = []
  const modelOption = system.models.find((item) => item.id === model.value)
  if (modelOption) parts.push(modelOption.name)
  parts.push(`${chat.state.messages.length} 条消息`)
  return parts.join(' · ')
})

async function loadConversation(id: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await chat.loadConversation(id)
  } catch (error) {
    ElMessage.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '加载会话失败')
  }
}

onMounted(async () => {
  void system.load().then(() => {
    if (system.enabled('knowledge')) void capabilityCatalog.loadKnowledgeCategories()
  })
  void capabilityCatalog.load()
  model.value = system.defaultModel
  reasoningEffort.value = system.defaultReasoningEffort

  const blocked = route.query.blocked
  if (typeof blocked === 'string' && BLOCKED_LABELS[blocked]) {
    ElMessage.info(`${BLOCKED_LABELS[blocked]}能力当前关闭，将在后续里程碑开放。`)
    const nextQuery = { ...route.query }
    delete nextQuery.blocked
    void router.replace({ query: nextQuery })
  }

  if (activeId.value) await loadConversation(activeId.value)
})

watch(
  () => system.defaultModel,
  (value) => {
    if (!model.value) model.value = value
  },
)

watch(
  () => system.defaultReasoningEffort,
  (value) => {
    reasoningEffort.value = value
  },
)

watch(
  () => route.query.c,
  (value) => {
    if (typeof value !== 'string') {
      if (!chat.state.streaming) chat.reset()
      return
    }
    if (value === chat.state.conversationId) return
    if (chat.state.streaming) return
    void loadConversation(value)
  },
)

watch(
  () => chat.state.conversationId,
  (id) => {
    if (!id || id === activeId.value) return
    void router.replace({ query: { ...route.query, c: id } })
  },
)

watch(
  () => chat.state.streaming,
  (streaming, previous) => {
    if (previous === true && !streaming) {
      void conversations.load()
    }
  },
)

// F1：命令面板选中「当前会话消息」后，等历史加载完再定位；定位成功即清空。
watch(
  () => [chat.pendingScrollMessageId, chat.state.conversationId, chat.state.messages.length] as const,
  async ([pendingId, conversationId, messageCount]) => {
    if (!pendingId || !conversationId || messageCount === 0) return
    await nextTick()
    if (messageListRef.value?.scrollToMessage(pendingId)) chat.clearPendingScroll()
  },
  { immediate: true },
)

const modelSelection = computed(() => ({
  model: model.value,
  reasoningEffort: reasoningEffort.value,
  reasoningSupported: system.reasoningEfforts.length > 0,
}))

function handleSend(payload: { text: string; context: ChatContextSelection }): void {
  void chat.send(payload.text, withModelSelection(payload.context, modelSelection.value))
}

function useSuggestion(text: string): void {
  void chat.send(text, withModelSelection({}, modelSelection.value))
}

async function handleApproval(id: string, approve: boolean): Promise<void> {
  const outcome = await chat.resolveApprovalById(id, approve)
  switch (outcome.kind) {
    case 'resumed':
      ElMessage.success(outcome.message)
      break
    case 'waiting_others':
      ElMessage.info(outcome.message)
      break
    case 'run_ended':
    case 'not_resumed':
      ElMessage.warning(outcome.message)
      break
    case 'expired':
    case 'already_decided':
      ElMessage.info(outcome.message)
      break
    default:
      ElMessage.error(outcome.message)
  }
}

I couldn't find node_modules path printed; the sed printed the source anyway. Key: fetchEventSource's Promise **resolves** when input signal aborts (it calls resolve() in the abort listener, line: inputSignal.addEventListener('abort', () => { dispose(); resolve(); })). So `runsApi.stream` resolves on abort, not rejects! This matters: performReconnect's `await runsApi.stream` resolves when aborted; then code checks `!currentController.signal.aborted` before scheduling → skip. finally: settled false, `!currentController.signal.aborted` false → no cleanup. Good.

But `startStream` with openChatStream: on abort (stop), fetchEventSource resolves; `startStream`'s try completes, finally: `if (!failed && !aborted && !isReconnecting())` false due aborted → no refresh. stop() handles. Good.

On normal server close: `onclose` then dispose → resolve. Note onclose called before resolve. Good.

On error thrown from onerror: `onerror` throws → catch innerErr → dispose() (aborts controller) → reject(innerErr). dispose() aborts curRequestController, which triggers? No inputSignal listener; the promise reject happens after. Fine.

Now: **when the input signal is aborted, fetchEventSource resolves (never rejects)**. So in `performReconnect`, if a user calls stop() while reconnect stream active, stop() aborts controller → runsApi.stream resolves; performReconnect's await resumes, checks aborted → skip; finally... fine. But in `runsApi.stream`'s 401 retry: if signal aborted during first attempt, streamOnce resolves (not rejects), so no refresh; fine.

Important consequence for **mock mode**: `mockRunStream` on abort rejects with AbortError (not resolve), unlike fetchEventSource which resolves. performReconnect catch checks isAbort → return. Fine. Minor semantic difference.

Another important consequence: in `connectRunStream`, `onclose` calls `handlers.onClose?.()` when server closes normally. In real M7, server closes after terminal event; good. In mock, `handlers.onClose?.()` explicitly after replay/wait; good.

Now, **big bug**: `fetchEventSource` auto-reconnects internally on error unless onerror throws. Our onerror throws, so no internal retry. Good.

**Critical bug candidate**: `fetchEventSource` sets `curRequestController` and aborts it in `dispose()`; dispose is called by inputSignal abort listener → resolve. Fine.

Now let's look at **event replay vs `run.started` clearing process** more concretely and whether it wipes cards in a real scenario. `replayPersistedEvents` is called only in adoptRun. Search usages of adoptRun in components: chat store `refresh` (UI "刷新状态" button), handleApiFailure run_in_progress, resolveApprovalById, performReconnect interrupted. `refresh()` is bound to RunRecoveryBanner's refresh. In that path, if state.runId equals run id (e.g., run_in_progress recovery where runId set in recovery but state.runId null? handleApiFailure run_in_progress sets recovery.runId but state.runId stays null? Let's re-check: before handleApiFailure, onError? The POST /chat/stream returns 409 run_in_progress; no onOpen, so state.runId is null (set at startStream). handleApiFailure sets state (keeps runId null) then `if (runId) await adoptRun(runId)`. adoptRun: runChanged=true → lastSeq 0; replay from 0. `run.started` replay clears process and sets runId. Good. But note **adoptRun calls `replayPersistedEvents` BEFORE setting recovery**; the replay's `run.started` sets streaming true; then run.interrupted sets approvals. Then adoptRun sets streaming false, recovery interrupted, syncPendingApprovals. Good.

But in refresh() after a **network error / stream_failed** where state.runId is set and lastSeq maybe 0 (because the stream failed before any event), replay from 0 clears process. Suppose during an active M7 stream, some tool cards were rendered, then connection dropped and reconnect attempts failed → degraded; lastSeq is e.g. 5, so replay from 5 — no run.started. Good.

But consider `state.runId` set by **loadConversation** from conversation.last_run with lastSeq 0 and process empty; user clicks "刷新状态" → adoptRun; runChanged false (runId same); replay from 0; run.started clears process (empty). Fine.

Now consider a scenario where the **current state has process cards from a NEWER run but state.runId is null**? Not likely.

**More serious**: `performReconnect` interrupted branch calls `adoptRun(run.id)` → replay from `state.lastSeq` (runChanged false). If `lastSeq` is high (e.g., 5 events processed live) and the run has been interrupted, persisted events may include an `approval.required` event with seq < lastSeq that was never delivered to this client (because the connection dropped before it) but lastSeq advanced past it due to a later event? Seq is monotonic; if event 5 wasn't received but event 6 was, impossible over one connection? The event bus could have gaps? Not realistically. OK.

Another: replay uses `after_seq` semantics "seq > after_seq"; lastSeq is highest processed; good.

**But in `adoptRun`, `replayPersistedEvents(run.id, runChanged ? 0 : state.value.lastSeq)`** — the call `state.value.lastSeq` is evaluated after `state.value` was updated with `runStatus` etc, same value. fine.

**run.started clearing process issue** in the test "回放事件按 seq 去重": second adoptRun replays after_seq=0 again? The test calls adoptRun twice; first sets lastSeq=3 (events 1,2,3; event 3 empty → skipped, so lastSeq stays 2? Wait event 3 has event '' → skipped before reduceChat, so lastSeq=2). Second adoptRun: runChanged false, lastSeq=2 → events API mock always returns same list with after_seq... the assertion only checks process length unchanged. The mock returns events 1,2,3 regardless of after_seq; seq 1,2 dropped by dedup; event 3 skipped. Fine.

But note: **empty-event events don't advance lastSeq**, so replay from lastSeq will re-fetch them next time; not a correctness issue.

Hmm, now the **`run.started` replay clearing process** could cause loss when the current run differs from the stream/poll... Let me think of a concrete scenario with **performReconnect encountering a different run via `GET /runs/{id}`**? It passes the same runId, so no.

What about **same run, but lastSeq reset to 0 by `onOpen` when reconnecting**? onOpen(runId,false) retains. Fine.

What about **`adoptRun` after approval resumed when controller null**: resolveApprovalById approves; result.run_id same; state.lastSeq e.g. 8 (approval.required seq), adoptRun replay from 8. The run now running; replay from 8 returns events after approval (maybe run.resumed seq 9 etc). Good. run.started not included. Then adoptRun sets recovery run_in_progress and polling; streaming true. But there is no active SSE. Polling every 2.5s; at terminal, refreshHistory. So user sees process cards updated only via polling? `pollRun` updates status and recovery, but **does not replay new persisted events** during polling! Only on entering adoptRun. So after approval resume via polling, new tool cards (tool.start/tool.result) emitted after the stream closed will NOT appear until terminal refreshHistory (which only reloads messages, not process). Then at terminal, `reconcileRunApprovals` + refreshHistory, but process cards after resume are lost (no replay at terminal). Hmm: `pollRun` on terminal doesn't call replayPersistedEvents. The M7 goal "进入会话/重连降级时补齐工具卡" — but poll path doesn't. However this is M5/M6 pre-existing poll behavior; M7 added replay in adoptRun only, so if you enter adoptRun and then poll through a resumed run, new events aren't replayed. Is that a bug relative to M7? Maybe a design limitation. The report says "先回放已落库事件补卡，再进入审批横幅/轮询" — only initial. Not claiming continuous. The task focus asks about replay pagination and run.started clearing process. Maybe there is a specific test/plan requirement. Let me read the plan's Review Focus and tasks to know expected behavior. This is important to check test coverage claims (六条 Review Focus). Let me read the plan.

3: > **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
4: 
5: **Goal:** 让前端消费后端已落地的 M7 契约：运行事件 SSE 续流、事件回放 `event` 字段、agents/tasks 写操作 RBAC、审批事件 5 字段、A2A 授权链接白名单，并修掉 B-1/B-2/B-3 三个纯前端缺陷、补齐 Nginx 续流 location。
6: 
7: **Architecture:** 契约层先行（`types` → `api` → `mock`），再改 `chat` store 的重连状态机为「续流优先、失败回退轮询」，最后做视图层权限显隐与错误文案收口。续流沿用 `@microsoft/fetch-event-source`（GET + Bearer），用 `lastSeq` 单调去重，400 `replay_too_large` 回退轮询，终态关闭后 `refreshHistory()`。
8: 
9: **Tech Stack:** Vue 3.5 / TypeScript 6 / Vite 8 / Pinia 4 / @microsoft/fetch-event-source / Vitest 5 / Playwright / Nginx 1.31（容器内 dev_nginx）。

13: ## Global Constraints
14: 
15: - 后端契约以 `agent-hub` 实际实现为准（2026-11-11 已落地 Task 1–4）：`GET /runs/{id}/stream?after_seq=`、`RunEventOut.event`、`AdminUser` 门禁、`approval.required` 5 字段。

17: - `seq` 单调去重，`lastSeq` 只前进；回放事件与实时事件走同一个 `reduceChat`。
18: - `message.delta` 不落库：断线窗口内逐字补齐**不承诺**，终态必须 `refreshHistory()`。
19: - 400 `replay_too_large` → 回退轮询，**不**用同一 `after_seq` 重试；404/连接失败同样回退轮询。

lines.text: # M7 前端契约适配 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.
**Goal:** 让前端消费后端已落地的 M7 契约：运行事件 SSE 续流、事件回放 `event` 字段、agents/tasks 写操作 RBAC、审批事件 5 字段、A2A 授权链接白名单，并修掉 B-1/B-2/B-3 三个纯前端缺陷、补齐 Nginx 续流 location。

**Architecture:** 契约层先行（`types` → `api` → `mock`），再改 `chat` store 的重连状态机为「续流优先、失败回退轮询」，最后做视图层权限显隐与错误文案收口。续流沿用 `@microsoft/fetch-event-source`（GET + Bearer），用 `lastSeq` 单调去重，400 `replay_too_large` 回退轮询，终态关闭后 `refreshHistory()`。
**Tech Stack:** Vue 3.5 / TypeScript 6 / Vite 8 / Pinia 4 / @microsoft/fetch-event-source / Vitest 5 / Playwright / Nginx 1.31（容器内 dev_nginx）。
- 后端契约以 `agent-hub` 实际实现为准（2026-11-11 已落地 Task 1–4）：`GET /runs/{id}/stream?after_seq=`、`RunEventOut.event`、`AdminUser` 门禁、`approval.required` 5 字段。
- 续流必须用 `fetch`/`fetch-event-source`（`EventSource` 不支持 `Authorization`）；`id: seq`、`event: 名称`、`data: JSON`、15s `: ping` 注释帧。
- `seq` 单调去重，`lastSeq` 只前进；回放事件与实时事件走同一个 `reduceChat`。
- `message.delta` 不落库：断线窗口内逐字补齐**不承诺**，终态必须 `refreshHistory()`。
- 400 `replay_too_large` → 回退轮询，**不**用同一 `after_seq` 重试；404/连接失败同样回退轮询。
- 403 `forbidden` 统一文案「当前账号无管理员权限」，不当作登录失效、不触发 refresh。
- 登录 401 不进入 refresh 流程（排除 `/auth/login`、`/auth/register`），直接展示后端 `error.message`。
- 503 `database_unavailable` / `service_unavailable` 统一文案「服务暂不可用，请稍后重试」；知识库检索面板保留自己的专用文案。
- 不伪造后端能力：无接口页面不做假 CRUD；mock 与真实路径必须走同一 store 代码。
- 不新增依赖、不改 `package.json` 依赖版本；不启动新容器。
- 提交信息 `feat|fix|test|docs|build(scope): 中文摘要`，每个 Task 一个提交，**只本地提交不推送**。
以下六类输入/失败模式最容易在验收时才暴露，每条都在对应 Task 有测试：
1. **断线发生在 run 建立之前**（还没有 `runId`）：不能续流，必须保持原有重试/降级路径 → Task 3 单测。
2. **续流 400 `replay_too_large`**：必须降级轮询且不弹致命错误、不重复用同 `after_seq` → Task 3 单测。
3. **run 已终态时续流**：立即关闭并 `refreshHistory()`，不得反复重连 → Task 3 单测。
4. **回放事件 `event` 为空/未知**：忽略并记录，不猜测事件名、不污染 `lastSeq` 之外的 state → Task 2 单测。
5. **普通用户直接调用写接口 403**：展示统一权限文案，不能当成「登录过期」或静默 → Task 5/6 单测。
6. **登录密码错误 401**：显示「邮箱或密码错误」且不触发 refresh/登出 → Task 6 单测。
- **Phase 1（串行，root）**：Task 1 → Task 2 → Task 3。三者共享 `src/types/run.ts`、`src/api/runs.ts`、`src/api/mock/stream.ts`、`src/stores/chat.ts`，必须串行。
- **Phase 2（并行，子代理）**：Task 4（RBAC 视图）、Task 5（审批/授权 UI）、Task 6（client 错误文案）、Task 7（Nginx）。文件互不重叠。
- **Phase 3（串行，root）**：Task 8 文档同步 + 全量门禁 + 独立审查。
- `RunEvent.event: string`（原始 SSE 事件名，缺失为空串）；

- `interface RunStreamHandlers { onOpen?: (runId: string | null) => void; onEvent: (event: ChatEventName, data: unknown) => void; onError: (error: Error) => void; onClose?: () => void; signal: AbortSignal }`（复用 `ChatStreamHandlers`，从 `@/api/chat` 导出或抽到 `src/types`）；

- `runsApi.stream(runId: string, afterSeq: number, handlers: ChatStreamHandlers): Promise<void>`：mock 走 `mockRunStream`，真实走 `fetchEventSource(`${resolveBaseUrl()}/runs/${runId}/stream?after_seq=${afterSeq}`, { method: 'GET', headers: { Authorization, Accept }, signal, openWhenHidden: true })`；

Now let's check Nginx regex location priority: In nginx, regex locations are checked in order after the longest prefix match unless the longest prefix has `^~`. `location /api/` is a prefix; regex location will take precedence over prefix unless `^~`. So correct. But another subtlety: `location = /api/v1/chat/stream` exact wins. The regex `^/api/v1/runs/[0-9a-fA-F-]+/stream$` could match e.g. `/api/v1/runs/----/stream`, but that's fine. Also run id is UUID lowercase; fine. It won't conflict with chat stream. Good.

Static assertion false positive/negative: `findRunStreamLocation` finds first regex location whose URI contains /api/v1/runs/ and /stream; requirement says only regex. It doesn't verify the location is inside the server block or that the regex is anchored properly; also `RUN_STREAM_LOCATION_EXPECTED` unused (defined but not compared) — it's only in the error message. So a misconfigured regex like `location ~ /stream` would pass "includes" check. Also `checkDeployStaticConfig` checks `/^[ \t]*location[ \t]+\^~[ \t]+\/api(?:\/|[ \t{])/m` — only detects `^~ /api/` exactly; not `^~ /api` (without slash)? regex: `\/api(?:\/|[ \t{])` → `location ^~ /api` followed by space matches via `[ \t{]`? It requires `[ \t]` after api; yes "location ^~ /api {" matches because `[ \t{]` includes space. Hmm wait, after `\/api` group `(?:\/|[ \t{])` matches a single space. Then the regex ends; yes matches. Fine. But other prefixes like `^~ /api/v1/` would not match because after `/api` comes `/` → match. Actually `\/api(?:\/|[ \t{])` matches `/api/` prefix, yes. Good.

But the assertion only looks for directives anywhere in the block, not that they're not commented (extractBracedBlock `inComment` handles comments? It skips comments; but the required directive regex uses `^[ \t]*` and does not exclude comment lines: e.g. a commented-out `# proxy_buffering off;` would match? The pattern `^[ \t]*proxy_buffering` would not match `# proxy_buffering off;` because of `#` before space. If comment line is `    # proxy_buffering off;`, after whitespace comes #, so no. Fine. But if directive is in a nested location inside? extract block includes nested text; regex could match nested unrelated directives; not a big deal.

However, the static check claims 7 directives and the test maybe asserts. But `RUN_STREAM_LOCATION_EXPECTED` is only used in error; the actual regex allows any run-id chars. Minor: dead constant.

More important: **The `/api/` prefix is not `^~` currently, good.** But the static check `location ^~ /api` etc. Fine. What about `location ^~ /api/`? matches. Another prefix `location /api/` is okay.

One subtle Nginx issue: **`proxy_cache off;` in a location that has no `proxy_cache_path`** is fine (default off). `gzip off` fine.

Another: `proxy_pass http://agent-hub-backend;` without URI in regex location: For regex locations with proxy_pass without URI, nginx passes normalized URI; fine.

Potential real issue: **Nginx regex location is case-sensitive and only matches lowercase hex UUID**; backend run IDs are UUID v4 lowercase. The route uses `encodeURIComponent`, fine.

**Potential issue**: The pattern `[0-9a-fA-F-]+` is greedy and could match path traversal? `..` not in class. Fine.

Now, static assertion may not detect `location ~*` vs `~`; both regex. fine.

`checkDeploy` uses buildCheckConfig which may inject etc. Need to see if the static check runs before syntax check; if nginx container unavailable, static asserts pass then docker check fails. Docs claim exit 0; likely environment had container. Fine.

Docs numbers: README uncommitted says 317 tests; earlier committed README maybe says 316? Let's check committed README in HEAD, roadmap, etc. Also test count can be verified by running `pnpm test`. Let's count test files/`it`? Better run. But `pnpm test` might take ~1-2 min. Let's plan to run it later.

Now inspect RBAC tests (AgentsView.spec, TasksView.spec) and check they cover "direct call 403" claim. Let's read.

Interesting: TasksView spec test at line 239: for admin, expects row action labels `['补充','授权','拒绝','取消']` — note the "查看" button is hidden for admin because row has available_actions. That matches code. For non-admin, only "查看". Fine.

But potential issue: For admin, `TasksView` has **no "查看" button when available_actions non-empty**; how does admin open detail drawer? Clicking a row? Let's check TasksView template: maybe row click opens drawer. Let me read around the table. Also for non-admin, they get only "查看"; good.

The tasks detail drawer test "默认 canManage=false 时不渲染任何动作按钮" expects `findAll('button')` length 0. But the drawer might have close buttons? el-drawer stubbed. Also "授权链接不可用" prompt only shows if `canManage` true; non-admin sees no prompt at all even if auth_required — is that okay? The M7 requirement "无链接时显示授权链接不可用" maybe applies to admins only (since authorization is admin-only). For non-admins, they can't authorize; showing "请联系管理员" might be useful. But not a defect.

**Potential RBAC gap**: `AgentRegisterDialog` `preview` endpoint remains available to all logged-in users per contract; the dialog isn't reachable for non-admin. Fine.

**Potential RBAC gap in ChatView**: A2A task cards in chat allow resume/authorize? Let's check `ApprovalCard` etc. Tasks APIs are only used in TasksView and TaskDetailDrawer. But A2A `a2a.auth_required` card in chat maybe has button linking to tasks page. Fine.

Now **403 handling**: Where do views show errors? `errorMessage()` from Error; `apiErrorFromResponse` normalizes. Good. But the 403 message "当前账号无管理员权限" could be shown for `POST /knowledge/documents` with scope=system non-admin 403 forbidden. That's a non-admin-admin-message mismatch: knowledge upload with `scope=system` for non-admin returns 403 `forbidden`; the unified message says "当前账号无管理员权限", which is actually appropriate-ish (needs admin). Fine.

Could 403 `forbidden` be returned for a non-admin trying to access another user's resource? Probably `not_found`. Let's grep docs for 403 usage:

content.text:
Url length test: `https://example.com/` (20 chars) + 2000 = 2020 > 2000 → false. Fine.

But the comment in `authorizationUrl.ts` says "前端不重复实现内网判定策略，只保留与之一致的最小防线：协议白名单 + 本地回环 http". It then allows any https URL including `https://10.0.0.8/...` (internal IP over https) — backend would set null for internal, so frontend guard doesn't need to. But **if backend is older/misconfigured and returns `https://169.254.169.254/...` (metadata endpoint via https)** the frontend would allow it. The backend is authoritative. It's a defense-in-depth gap; probably Minor. Also allows `https://evil.com` by design (authorization_url should be external). Fine.

Now, an important issue with `TaskDetailDrawer`: `showAuthorizationUnavailable` only when `props.canManage` true. For a non-admin on an auth_required task, no link shown (button hidden) and no message. Maybe acceptable since non-admin can't do anything; but requirement in plan says "authorization_url 为 null 时显示提示" (not restricted to admin). The task 5 interface says "null/非法 → 提示文案 + 隐藏「打开授权链接」". The code hides the prompt for non-admin. Could be an Important spec deviation? The review asks "A2A authorization_url 白名单 ... 非法置 null" and "写入口". The prompt "授权链接不可用，请联系管理员" for non-admins is arguably useful. But is it a bug? Since non-admin can't authorize anyway; showing "请联系管理员" tells the wrong workflow maybe. Hmm.

Another issue: `TaskDetailDrawer` `goAuthorize` still has the guard and ElMessage; fine.

**Approval payload priority**: `syncPendingApprovals` hydrates from `GET /approvals?run_id=...&status=all`, and `approvalToProcess` sets payload = approval.payload (full) and payloadPreview. Since event-derived approval card already has payloadPreview, the fallback fetch is triggered on run.interrupted (onEvent) regardless of whether the event had payload_preview. The design/plan says "hydrateApprovals 只在事件缺 payload/字段时调用 `/approvals?run_id=` 兜底，已有则跳过" (Task 5 file list). But the implementation didn't change syncPendingApprovals; it always fetches on run.interrupted and after replay. So the plan requirement "只在事件缺字段时调用兜底，已有则跳过" is NOT implemented. Is that a functional problem? It means an extra API call on every interruption, and the fetched `Approval.payload` (full) takes precedence over the M7 event's redacted `payload_preview` in the UI — possibly exposing full payload (though `redactValue` masks sensitive keys client-side, and backend approvals list also presumably returns payload? Is payload redacted server-side? The card has `containsSensitiveKey`/`redactValue` masking). The report §3 says "M7-F4 审批字段 | ApprovalCard 优先渲染事件 5 字段；无 payload 时用 payload_preview". But in the store, if the approval list fallback returns `payload`, the card will show "查看参数" with redacted full payload rather than "参数预览（已脱敏）". Is that a violation of "优先消费事件脱敏预览字段"? The commit f95e5ad "审批卡优先消费事件脱敏预览字段" — maybe the intent was to avoid the `ApprovalCard` requesting detail. But the store fetch causes full payload. Let's check the plan's Task 5 interface: "Modify src/stores/chat.ts (hydrateApprovals 只在事件缺 payload/字段时调用 /approvals?run_id= 兜底，已有则跳过)". The implementation did NOT modify syncPendingApprovals. The report says "有事件字段时不再依赖详情请求" — but code does still request. Let me verify syncPendingApprovals is indeed called when approval.required event arrives — only on `run.interrupted`, not immediately on approval.required. It's triggered by run.interrupted (which follows approval.required). So yes, always one request. Also for replay path adoptRun interrupted: `syncPendingApprovals`. The plan says "只在事件缺 payload/字段时调用 ... 兜底，已有则跳过" which was NOT done. Let's flag as Important? It's a plan deviation and extra request, and it overrides the event's `payload_preview` with full payload from the approvals API. Is that a security regression? The approvals API itself is authorized and returns the approval payload; that's existing behavior. Not critical.

The commit list has `f95e5ad feat(m7): 审批卡优先消费事件脱敏预览字段` which only modified ApprovalCard plus spec. So the plan item was dropped. The report should be truthful. Let me re-read performReconnect and think about `lastSeq` reset on `onOpen` — one thing: In `performReconnect`, after GET run, it calls `state.value = {... state.value, conversationId: run.conversation_id, runId: run.id, runStatus: run.status}`. Then `runsApi.stream(runId, state.value.lastSeq, ...)`. But `onOpen` for reconnect is called with `resetSeq=false`; onOpen sets `state.value.lastSeq = resetSeq || runChanged ? 0 : state.value.lastSeq` and `runStatus: state.value.runStatus ?? 'running'`. Fine.

**But `onOpen` sets `state.value.recovery = null` and `streaming = true`.** Fine.

**`onOpen` also calls `clearReconnectTimer()` and `unbindConnectivityListeners()`**. Note performReconnect is being called from a timer; onOpen clears timer (already null) and unbinds listeners. Then if stream drops, onClose → scheduleReconnect → bind again. OK. But consider **offline during in-flight reconnect**: performReconnect called when online. Then stream open. Network drops. scheduleReconnect: `navigator.onLine === false` → clear timer, return, *but it has already unbound listeners in onOpen* and re-binds in scheduleReconnect (bindConnectivityListeners at line 491 before offline check) → good.

**Reconnect on browser 'online' while `reconnectInFlight` true**: onBrowserOnline resets attempts and returns if in flight. Then when the in-flight attempt fails, scheduleReconnect increments from 0 → delay 1s. Hmm okay.

**Potential bug in `scheduleReconnect` when called while connection === 'reconnecting' and reconnectTimer === null and reconnectInFlight === true**: guard only returns if timer !== null. In `performReconnect` catch → scheduleReconnect is called *inside* performReconnect before finally sets reconnectInFlight=false. So it schedules a timer while in flight; when timer fires 1s later, reconnectInFlight should be false (finally synchronous before timer). Fine.

But consider `onStreamClose` called while `performReconnect`'s runsApi.stream still pending (fetch resolves after onclose). onStreamClose → scheduleReconnect (connection open, timer null) → sets reconnecting + timer. Then performReconnect after await sees `!currentController.signal.aborted && finishReason===null && !terminal` → calls scheduleReconnect again — guard: connection reconnecting && reconnectTimer !== null → return. Finally: `!settled && !aborted && !isReconnecting()` → isReconnecting true → skip. Good. **But streaming stays true**, connection reconnecting. Good.

**Critical race: `scheduleReconnect` called from `onStreamClose` while the stream is still "in flight" and then the timer fires before performReconnect's finally?** Timer delay ≥1000ms; performReconnect resumes immediately after fetchEventSource resolves (same microtask) so fine.

**What about `onStreamClose` when the reconnect stream closes because the **user aborted** via `stopReconnect`?** stopReconnect aborts reconnectController → fetchEventSource resolves *without* onclose (abort listener resolves, no onclose). state: resetReconnectBudget clears timer, connection set degraded, recovery. But performReconnect's await resumes: currentController.signal.aborted → skip; finally: settled false, aborted → no cleanup. `reconnectInFlight=false`. Good. But `stopReconnect` doesn't set `lastAttempt` null, and degraded recovery exists. User can click "重试发送" → startStream POST. Hmm. In the stopReconnect case, perhaps should offer manual reconnect (not resend). Is there a UI for "重新连接"? RunRecoveryBanner buttons: "重试发送" (stream_failed) / "刷新状态" / "放弃本轮". "刷新状态" calls chat.refresh: if runId && (streaming || interrupted) adoptRun; else refreshHistory. In degraded after stopReconnect, streaming false, runStatus likely running (not interrupted) → refreshHistory only, which doesn't re-establish stream, just reloads messages. Hmm, "刷新状态" may not restart streaming. But this is pre-existing UI. Not M7.

Now the real **M7-specific issue with 400 replay_too_large**: enterDegraded starts polling and sets `recovery.stream_failed` with `retryable: true`. The banner shows "重试发送", clicking it calls `startStream` with same clientMessageId → POST /chat/stream. If the backend responds with **the same run** (idempotent replay) then this would actually restart the stream for that run and possibly hit replay_too_large again, or if backend returns 409 run_in_progress (since run is active), handleApiFailure removes optimistic message and adoptRun. Let's see: `handleApiFailure` for run_in_progress does `removeMessage(attempt.clientMessageId)` and adoptRun → replayPersistedEvents from after 0 (runChanged true? state.runId was run-1, so false → after_seq=lastSeq). Wait: in the replay_too_large scenario, state.runId is run-1 and lastSeq is high (why would replay exceed 1000? Because after_seq maybe 0 if reconnect occurred before any event received; or lastSeq far behind). adoptRun after 409: runChanged false → replay from lastSeq → could again exceed 1000 but replayPersistedEvents catches errors silently and then polling. So eventually poll. Not a duplicate run, but a pointless POST. More importantly, the banner's "重试发送" semantic is wrong for a stream-level failure; but pre-existing M6 behavior. The M7 plan's design says "400 时回退轮询" and "不再重发消息". The presence of "重试发送" button for `stream_failed` (degraded) contradicts "不再重发消息" somewhat. But it's user-initiated retry, not automatic. Could be acceptable. Hmm.

Actually, there's a more serious issue: **`enterDegraded` from 400 sets `recovery.kind='stream_failed'` and `retryable: true`, and the run is still **streaming on the server**. The polling path will update runStatus; when terminal, refreshHistory. Fine. The user may click "重试发送" and POST /chat/stream; backend returns 409 run_in_progress (most likely) → front-end removes optimistic user message and adopts the existing run. No duplicate run. If backend is idempotent and returns the same run stream, it would replay from scratch and hit 400 replay_too_large again → startStream's catch handleApiFailure? Actually `openChatStream` on 400 -> ApiRequestError; startStream catch: failed=true; `canAutoReconnect(error)` → 400 is 4xx → false; handleApiFailure → 4xx error branch (not rate_limited/run_in_progress) → removeMessage, error/recovery stream_failed retryable false. So user gets error. Not duplicated run. Fine.

Let me now inspect **`onEvent` unknown event handling in runs.ts**: `if (!event.event || event.event === 'ping') return; if (!isChatEvent) console.debug`. For ping frames the SSE parser may not emit event for comment lines; fine.

**`event.data` empty for ping**; fine.

**`id` not used** — seq comes from data payload. Contract says data includes seq. But the plan said "用 payload.seq（后端 payload 内含 seq）". Good. But is it guaranteed for all SSE frames? Docs: "payload 内含 seq" — yes.

Now, **event replay `seq`**: `const seq = typeof payload.seq === 'number' ? payload.seq : item.seq`; `{...payload, seq}`. But what if payload.seq is a **string** (JSON numbers usually number)? Backend Pydantic seq int → number. Fine.

**Potential bug: replay applies event by event without awaiting; synchronous. Fine.**

**Pagination: `if (!result.has_more || !result.next_cursor) break`** — Suppose backend returns `has_more: true` and `next_cursor: null` for cursor-based pagination? Unlikely. Suppose `limit=200` but backend caps at 100 and returns has_more + next_cursor; fine. Suppose backend ignores `after_seq` when `cursor` provided and returns events from beginning; reduceChat dedup by seq protects duplicates (seq <= lastSeq drops). Fine.

**But `after_seq` is passed on every page along with cursor**, and the API might treat after_seq and cursor as mutually exclusive (400)? Check docs api for runs events params. Let's grep.

约定：

- 401 由拦截器清理会话，页面不必重复处理；
- 业务错误展示 `message`，调试信息记录 `code` + `request_id`；
- 网络错误（status=0）提示「网络异常，请稍后重试」。

## 6. 类型与 OpenAPI

当前 `src/types/` 为手写契约类型。后续可选：

```bash
# 从后端 OpenAPI 生成类型（规划）
pnpm dlx openapi-typescript http://localhost:8000/openapi.json -o src/types/openapi.d.ts
```

生成后仍需保留 UI 层类型（如带本地状态的 `ChatMessage`），不要直接用生成类型做组件状态。

## 7. 并发与缓存

- 同一会话同时只允许一个运行：发送前检查 `chat.streaming`，否则禁用输入；
- 列表请求用 cursor 分页，不缓存全量；
- 写操作成功后失效相关 store 的列表缓存（简单 invalidate，不做持久化缓存）；
- 重复点击提交用 loading 锁，避免重复创建。

## 8. 调试

```bash
# 直接看 SSE 原始帧
curl -N -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/chat/stream \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"message":"你好"}'
```

浏览器 DevTools：

- Network → 选中 SSE 请求 → EventStream 面板看事件；
- 若长时间无输出，检查 Nginx `proxy_buffering off`；
- 401 检查 localStorage token 与后端时钟偏差。

## 9. 个人能力层接口（M1.5，已实现）

| 功能 | 接口 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 指令 | `GET/PUT /instructions` | 生效指令、来源（user/system_default）、默认值、4000 字符上限 |
| 长期记忆 | `/memories` | 列表/新增/修改/删除/清空/导出，支持 `kind`、`status`、`q` |
| 技能 | `/skills`、`/skills/catalog` | 系统 + 用户技能；zip 导入；参考文件读取 |
| MCP | `/mcp/servers`、`/mcp/available` | 系统 + 用户服务器；工具发现；凭据只回显提示 |

请求仍走 `/api/v1`，认证、错误信封与分页约定同上。设置页四区块与输入栏「+」选择器已按此契约实现；显式选择只影响当次请求。

## 10. 知识库接口（M4，已实现）

Confirmed: `loadConversation` does not call `adoptRun` or replay. So entering an interrupted run after page refresh:
- process is empty
- `syncPendingApprovals(lastRun.id)` adds approval cards (hydration) but no tool cards
- polling; if approval decided elsewhere, poll sees running → sets recovery run_in_progress, streaming true, but no replay of new events. At terminal, refreshHistory reloads messages but process may only have the approval card.

The report §3/replay claim "进入会话/恢复运行时会用 GET /runs/{id}/events 的 event 回放补卡" is **false for the loadConversation path**, which is the main "进入会话" path. The M7 plan Task 2 says "在 adoptRun 拿到非终态 run 后...调用" — only adoptRun, so the plan itself only required adoptRun. But the plan Task 2 interface says "在 adoptRun 与续流降级前调用" (line 74). Let me re-read: "Modify src/stores/chat.ts（新增 replayPersistedEvents(...)，在 adoptRun 与续流降级前调用）". The implementation calls only in adoptRun, not "续流降级前". Hmm, "续流降级前" — before entering degraded, would replay events to fill cards? Not implemented. So plan deviation. But is it a bug? When reconnect degrades (e.g., after 5 failures), the process cards from missed events are not replayed; polling updates status only. At terminal, refreshHistory only messages. So **tool/approval cards emitted during the outage are permanently missing from the process panel** until... possibly a later adoptRun. That seems like an intended feature of M7 event replay ("用于补齐已落库过程项") but the implementation only replays on adoptRun, not on degradation/terminal. Wait, `enterDegraded` → schedulePolling; `pollRun` at terminal → reconcile approvals + refreshHistory, no replay. So the M7 feature "event replay" doesn't help in the primary reconnect-failure scenario! Let's check where adoptRun is called after degraded: user clicking "刷新状态" → refresh(): `runId && (streaming || interrupted)`; after degraded, streaming false, runStatus 'running' → so refresh() calls refreshHistory, NOT adoptRun. So even manual refresh doesn't replay. Hmm, so M7's replay only triggers on: adoptRun (initial run_in_progress 409, reconnect sees interrupted, approval resumed with no controller, refresh while streaming). For the degraded path, no replay. The design might intend "续流降级前" replay. Let's read design §3 to see exact requirements.

61:## 2. 编号与对齐规则
62:
63:1. **M 编号同名同义**：前端 M7/M8/M9 与后端一一对应，只描述同一里程碑下的前端交付；不再单独定义一套里程碑。
64:2. **X1 / X2 升级**：后端立项后，前端 X1 → M9、X2 → M8；历史文档中的 X1/X2 保留为「原编号」，新文档一律用 M9/M8。
65:3. **F 系列只承载纯前端横切**：F1 已完成；原计划的 F2 收尾项并入 M7 前端，不新立编号。未来纯前端工作（如 v7 像素级视觉还原、拖拽编排器）按需新立 F3+。
66:4. **契约先行，真实联调才算完成**：状态口径仍为 `未开始` → `契约先行` → `实现中` → `已联调`；mock 通过只算「实现中」。
67:5. **不伪造后端能力**：无契约页面只做只读/内置数据呈现，并显式提示「后端未提供接口」，不做本地假 CRUD、不显示假成功。
68:
69:## 3. M7 前端适配（高优先）
70:
71:### 3.1 目标
72:
73:让前端在 M7 后端落地后能够：
74:
75:1. 断线后从 `lastSeq` **增量续流**（回放已落库事件 + 接续实时），终态仍用 `refreshHistory()` 补齐断线窗口内未落库的文本；
76:2. 用事件回放的 `event` 字段做 reducer 重放（补工具卡/审批卡/消息）；
77:3. 正确处理 agents/tasks 写操作的 403，并按角色真实显隐管理员入口；
78:4. 审批卡直接消费 `approval.required` 的 5 个新字段，减少一次详情请求；
79:5. 跟随后端更严格的 A2A 授权 URL 白名单（前端已有 https/localhost 限制，无需新增放行逻辑）；
80:6. 修掉登录 401 文案、全局 503 文案两个纯前端问题，并补真实 403 文本证据。
81:
82:### 3.2 范围
83:
84:| 子项 | 内容 | 依赖后端 |
85:|---|---|---|
86:| M7-F1 续流 | 接入 `GET /runs/{id}/stream?after_seq=`；重连路径改为「续流优先、失败回退轮询」 | M7-1 |
87:| M7-F2 事件回放 | `RunEventOut.event` 进入类型；reducer 可按事件名重放；补卡与去重 | M7-1 |
88:| M7-F3 权限边界 | agents/tasks 写入口按 `role=admin` 显隐/禁用；403 `forbidden` 文案；管理员入口按角色 | M7-2 |
89:| M7-F4 审批字段 | `approval.required` 5 字段直接渲染；详情请求保留为兜底 | M7-3 |
90:| M7-F5 授权链接 | 前端已有 https + localhost 限制；补「后端会置空非法 URL」的容错用例 | M7-4 |
91:| M7-F6 纯前端收尾 | B-1 登录 401 文案、B-2 全局 503 文案、B-3 管理员入口（与 M7-F3 合并验收） | 无 |
92:| M7-F7 契约与门禁 | 类型/mock/fixtures/OpenAPI 手写类型同步；单测与联调用例 | M7-1..4 |
93:
94:### 3.3 契约（以 M7 立项与实施计划为基线，落地以 handoff/OpenAPI 为准）
95:
96:#### 3.3.1 运行事件回放
97:
98:```http
99:GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/events?after_seq=&limit=
100:```
101:
102:- 响应元素新增 `event: string`：原始 SSE 事件名（如 `message.delta`、`approval.required`、`message.done`）；
103:- `type` 仍保留分类（run/message/tool/approval/…）；
104:- `payload` 继续剔除内部字段 `_event`；
105:- 旧字段零变化；`event` 为空/缺失时按未知事件忽略并记录 `type`/`seq`，不猜测事件名（`payload` 不保留 `_event`）。
106:
107:#### 3.3.2 SSE 续流端点
108:
109:```http
110:GET /api/v1/runs/{run_id}/stream?after_seq=0
111:Authorization: Bearer <token>
112:Accept: text/event-stream
113:```
114:
115:- 帧格式与 `POST /chat/stream` 一致：`id: <seq>`、`event: <名称>`、`data: <JSON>`，每 15s `: ping`；
116:- 先回放 `seq > after_seq` 的已落库事件，再订阅实时事件；终态事件后关闭；
117:- run 已终态：回放完即关闭；`interrupted`：保持连接等审批恢复；
118:- 错误：未登录 401；非本人/不存在 404（不泄露存在性）；回放超过 1000 条 400 `replay_too_large`；
119:- 单实例前提；不提供 `Last-Event-ID`，用 query `after_seq`；
120:- 前端必须用 `fetch`/`@microsoft/fetch-event-source`（EventSource 不支持自定义 Authorization）。
121:
122:#### 3.3.3 写操作 RBAC
123:
124:- agents 写接口（`POST /agents`、`PATCH/DELETE /agents/{id}`、`refresh`、`health`）与 tasks 动作接口（`cancel/resume/authorize/reject`）改为仅管理员；
125:- 普通用户返回 403 `forbidden`，`details.required_role="admin"`；
126:- 读接口 `GET /agents*`、`GET /tasks*` 与 `POST /agents/preview` 保持登录用户可用；
127:- 被拒绝的写操作后端记审计 `security.rbac_denied`。
128:- **行为变更**：M7 前普通用户本可调用这些写接口（前端只是隐藏入口）；M7 后统一 403。前端需准备普通用户第二账号，补「入口不可见 + 直接调用 403」两层回归，不能当成「新增按钮权限」。
129:
130:#### 3.3.4 审批事件字段
131:
132:`approval.required.data` 新增：
133:
134:```text
135:tool_display_name  string   工具展示名
136:executor           string   执行方（native/skill/mcp/a2a）
137:target             string   操作目标（≤2000）
138:side_effect        string   副作用/风险说明
139:payload_preview    string   脱敏后的参数预览（≤500）
140:```
141:
142:字段只增不减；前端可直接渲染审批卡，`GET /approvals?run_id=` 保留为兜底。
143:
144:#### 3.3.5 A2A 授权 URL
145:
146:- 后端只允许 `https`，dev/test 额外允许 `http://localhost`、`http://127.0.0.1`；
147:- 非法协议、内网/回环（prod）、超长（>2000）一律置 `authorization_url=null`，任务状态不变；
148:- 前端已有「仅 https/本地 http」判断；无链接时显示「授权链接不可用，请联系管理员」而不是空按钮。
149:
150:### 3.4 前端设计
151:
152:#### 3.4.1 文件影响
153:
154:| 文件 | 改动 |
155:|---|---|
156:| `src/types/run.ts` | `RunEvent` 增 `event: string`；续流参数类型 |
157:| `src/types/chat.ts` | `ApprovalRequiredPayload` 增 5 字段；事件白名单不变 |
158:| `src/api/runs.ts` | 新增 `openRunStream(runId, opts)`：`fetchEventSource` GET + Bearer + `after_seq`；`onEvent(name, data, seq)`；返回 `AbortController` |
159:| `src/stores/chat.ts` | 重连 action 改造：断线 → 校验 run → 续流（`lastSeq`）→ 去重消费；400 `replay_too_large`/连接失败 → 回退现有轮询 + `refreshHistory`；终态关闭 |
160:| `src/stores/auth.ts` | 暴露 `isAdmin`（`user.role === 'admin'`）供入口显隐 |
161:| `src/api/client.ts` | 401 拦截排除登录/注册/刷新；`handleApiFailure` 增加 403 `forbidden` 与 503 统一文案 |
162:| `src/views/AgentsView.vue` / `src/views/TasksView.vue` | 写按钮按 `isAdmin` 显示；403 时提示并刷新 |
163:| `src/components/chat/cards/ApprovalCard.vue` | 优先用事件 5 字段；缺字段时保留详情兜底 |
164:| `src/components/layout/SideNav.vue` / `router` | 管理台入口按角色显示（M8 页面落地前先保留设置页管理员分区） |
165:| `src/api/mock/` | 新增续流 mock、`event` 字段、403 脚本、审批 5 字段；fixtures 同步 |
166:| `deploy/nginx.conf` / `deploy/README.md` | 新增 `GET /api/v1/runs/{id}/stream` 的 SSE location（`proxy_buffering off` / `proxy_cache off` / `gzip off` / 长读超时）；否则生产续流会被缓冲或 60s 读超时截断 |
167:| `scripts/verify-nginx-sse.mjs` | `pnpm verify:nginx` 增加续流路径的逐帧对照（复用 chat/stream 的验证方式） |
168:
169:#### 3.4.2 续流状态机
170:
171:```mermaid
172:stateDiagram-v2
173:    [*] --> Streaming: POST /chat/stream
174:    Streaming --> Broken: 网络断开/正常 EOF 未终态
175:    Broken --> Verifying: GET /runs/{id}
176:    Verifying --> Replaying: 未终态
177:    Verifying --> Restoring: 已终态
178:    Replaying --> Streaming: 200 SSE（回放 + 实时）
179:    Replaying --> Polling: 400 replay_too_large / 404 / 连接失败
180:    Polling --> Restoring: 轮询到终态

Interesting: design §3.2 M7-F4: "详情请求保留为兜底" — always fetching is arguably acceptable ("保留为兜底" means it's still there). The report's "有事件字段时不再依赖详情请求" is more about the card not needing it. Not a strong issue. But plan's "已有则跳过" was a specific optimization not done. I'd report as Minor.

The design file impact table says `src/api/runs.ts` "新增 openRunStream(runId, opts)：... onEvent(name, data, seq)；返回 AbortController". Implementation signature differs (no seq third arg; uses handlers). Not important.

"M7-F4 审批字段 直接渲染；详情请求保留为兜底" fine.

Now let's read the rest of design 3.4.2 to see expectations for state machine (especially "Replaying --> Polling: ... 连接失败").
